name: Pedrosillo el Ralo (Spain)
description: Square flag divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, yellow at the lower hoist and white at the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pedrosillo el Ralo (roundels on green and a lion on white).
history: Municipal flag of Pedrosillo el Ralo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Pedrosillo el Ralo arms — roundels on green and lion on white
